R9492.summary: The French king's expected descent on Italy, 5,000 infantry in Provence, the fear of being played as Ottaviano Fregoso played the league in 1515, and money for pay. The key-B post data: Monsieur de Beaurain (Adrien de Croy, envoy to Bourbon) has arrived and will go on by carrack rather than by the brigantine leaving with Lorenzo Mormino.
